Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely concluded that the director was David Winters based on misleading search snippets and did not verify the credits on the actual Wikipedia/IMDb pages. This conflated “The Last Horror Movie” (2003, directed by Julian Richards) with David Winters (who directed “The Last Horror Film”), leading to the wrong birthplace.
